methodologyNotes: Covers gas-engine zero-turn riding lawn mowers in the residential and prosumer/entry-commercial class sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes battery-electric ZTRs, stand-on and walk-behind mowers, lawn/garden tractors, and heavy commercial units priced well above the consumer range. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. deckWidthIn is cutting deck width in inches. engineBrand is the engine manufacturer/series exactly as published (enum-style string, e.g. 'Kawasaki FR691V', 'Kohler 7000'). engineDisplacementCc is engine displacement in cubic centimeters. engineHp is manufacturer-rated gross horsepower in HP. topSpeedMph is maximum forward ground speed in miles per hour. transmissionType is the drive system as published (enum-style string, e.g. 'Hydro-Gear EZT', 'Hydro-Gear ZT-3100', 'dual hydrostatic'). deckConstruction is an enum: 'stamped' or 'fabricated'. fuelCapacityGal is fuel tank capacity in US gallons. cuttingHeightRangeIn is the deck cutting-height adjustment range in inches as 'low to high'. weightLbs is machine weight in pounds. warrantyYears is the residential limited warranty term in years; null if not disclosed.
